method: Read-only independent internal review; no new test execution or edits
checked_boundaries: New settings reject ambiguous booleans and oversized integers before scheduling; thresholds map actual lowercase asset identities and are not summed across decimals.

Idle scheduling uses attributed bucket idle and same-currency compound only; exact budget runtime, version, Vault getter/parent and chain cooldown are checked; no raw balance sweep or outgoing keeper transfer.
Adaptive scheduling validates exact Strategy/Registry runtime, bounded policy ABI/fingerprint, target/cooldown and only sends the pool ID; on-chain reviewed policy chooses width.
Global pause/preparation suppress both new actions; submission repeats preparation/accounting/code checks and simulation before durable signing intent.
Old pending hashes are recovered before new work; retired route configuration is allowed only for pending inspection and cannot schedule a new bridge call; no nonce or journal migration/reset.
Actual spend/receipts remain bounded by captured signing-time reviews; failures retain original pending state or confirmed-revert backoff.
operational_limits: Keeper maintenance policy reads use latest-state calls rather than one atomic snapshot; concurrent policy/cooldown changes can cause a skipped cycle or reverted simulation/transaction. On-chain guards remain authoritative; no guaranteed execution time.
Adaptive width selection and physical LP rebalance are separate transactions. A selected width does not mean the physical LP has moved until the subsequent guarded rebalance confirms.
Per-currency raw thresholds and maximum gas/daily budgets do not by themselves prove optimal economic maintenance timing; qualify real liquidity, prices, gas and alerts before production.

Changing optional profile/configuration while a legacy transaction is pending can require restoring valid reviewed configuration or disabling the optional feature for recovery; preserve the original journal and hash.
